steps.say: A compact solid, a rounded body and a low ring share a soft contact shadow. The shadow should follow their footprint rather than the units used to draw them.
At one tenth of the world size, the camera still fits the pieces. Their shadow should have the same proportions, with no huge gray rectangle behind them.
At ten times the original world size, the same shadow proportions and surface detail remain.
A tall narrow part throws a longer directional shadow. The receiving floor follows that projection rather than cutting it off at a small square around the base.
Rotating the narrow part changes its contact footprint and shadow without moving the model just to hide the shadow.
